Name: Fashion Sense - Save All Your Outfits
Author: NatrollEXE
Description:
This mod is a small utility mod for players who use Fashion Sense and want an easier way to back up their saved outfits.

Normally, Fashion Sense lets you copy the JSON data of only one saved outfit at a time. This mod makes the process much faster by exporting all your saved outfits at once, with each outfit stored in its own separate JSON file.
[heading][color=#3d85c6][size=4][b]Features[/b][/size][/color][/heading]
[list]
[*]Export all your saved Fashion Sense outfits at once.[/*]
[*]Save each outfit as an individual .json file.[/*]
[*]Name each file after its corresponding saved outfit.[/*]
[*]Organize backups by save file, player name, date, and time.[/*]
[*]Reimport outfits from an Imports folder.[/*]
[*]Optionally export your outfits automatically whenever the game is saved.[/*]
[/list][heading][color=#3d85c6][size=4][b]Default Controls[/b][/size][/color][/heading]
[list]
[*][b]F8[/b] – Export all saved Fashion Sense outfits.[/*]
[*][b]F9[/b] – Import outfits from the Imports folder.[/*]
[/list]
The keybinds can be changed through Generic Mod Config Menu, if installed, or manually through the config.json file.
[heading][color=#3d85c6][size=4][b]Where Are Exported Outfits Stored?[/b][/size][/color][/heading]
Exported outfits are saved inside the mod folder:

[code]Mods/Fashion Sense Save All Outfits/Backups/[/code]
The mod creates folders using the following structure:

[code]Backups/
  Save_123456789_PlayerName/
    2026-05-05_15-24-10/
      Outfit Name.json
      Another Outfit.json[/code]
This prevents backups from different save files or characters from getting mixed together.
[heading][color=#3d85c6][size=4][b]How to Import Outfits[/b][/size][/color][/heading]
To import outfits, place their .json files in the following folder:

[code]Mods/Fashion Sense Save All Outfits/Imports/[/code]
Next, load your save and press the import key, which is [b]F9[/b] by default.

If the Fashion Sense menu is already open, close it and open it again. If the imported outfits do not appear immediately, save the game and reload your save file.
[heading][color=#3d85c6][size=4][b]Import Behavior[/b][/size][/color][/heading]
By default, imported outfits are added to your current Fashion Sense outfit collection.

There is also a configuration option called ReplaceExistingOnImport. When set to true, your current outfit collection will be replaced with the imported outfits.

Use this option with caution. Creating a backup before replacing your current outfits is strongly recommended.
[heading][color=#3d85c6][size=4][b]Notes[/b][/size][/color][/heading]
This mod does not create outfits by itself. It only backs up and restores outfits that have already been saved through Fashion Sense.

Always back up your save files and important outfits, especially before using import options that replace existing data.
